w24 any NDD
```{r}
hold_w24<-n_w24
Result_table<- matrix(data=NA, nrow=683, ncol=5)
colnames(Result_table) <- c("Metabolites","OR", "CIL","CIH",
                            "p.value")
Result_table <- as.data.frame(Result_table)
j<- 1
for (i in 21:length(names(hold_w24)))
{
  my.formula <- paste("neu_dev")
  x.var <- paste(names(hold_w24)[i],"+ sex+
                             motherage + mother_smoking +ab_preg_yn + preeclampsia3rdtrimester +mother_bmi +ga +birthweight+ maternal_education+paternal_education+familyincome+alcohol_all+diabetes_all" )
  my.glm.formula <- as.formula(paste0(my.formula," ~ ", x.var))
  glm_model <- glm(my.glm.formula, na.action = na.omit, data=hold_w24,family = "binomial")
  print(tidy(glm_model))
  Result_table[j,1] <- names(hold_w24)[i]
  Result_table[j,2] <- round(exp(coef(glm_model)), 2)[2]#exp
  Result_table[j,3] <- round(exp(confint(glm_model)), 2)[2,1]#exp
  Result_table[j,4] <- round(exp(confint(glm_model)), 2)[2,2]#
  Result_table[j,5] <- round(tidy(glm_model)$p.value,4)[2]
  j <- j+1
}
################################################################
Result_table_name<-left_join(Result_table, pathway
                        %>% dplyr::select(Metabolites,CHEMICAL_NAME,Super_pathway), by ="Metabolites")
names(Result_table_name)
Result_table_fdr_neu_w24<-Result_table_name%>%
  mutate(FDR= p.adjust(Result_table_name$p.value,method="fdr"))

Result_table_Significant_neu_w24 <- subset(Result_table_fdr_neu_w24,p.value<= 0.05)
logtransform <- function(x, na.rm = FALSE) (x %>% log())
Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log <- Result_table_Significant_neu_w24 %>% mutate(across(c("OR":"CIH"), logtransform))

Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log<-Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log[with(Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log,order(FDR)),]
Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log_20 <- Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log %>%
 arrange(desc(abs(OR))) %>%
  slice(1:20)
```

```{r}
colnames(Result_table) <- c("Metabolites","OR", "CIL","CIH",
                            "p.value")
Result_table <- as.data.frame(Result_table)
j<- 1
for (i in 22:length(names(hold_18mth)))
{
  my.formula <- paste("neu_dev")
  x.var <- paste(names(hold_18mth)[i],"+ sex+ BMI18mth+maternal_education+paternal_education+familyincome" )
  
  my.glm.formula <- as.formula(paste0(my.formula," ~ ", x.var))
  glm_model <- glm(my.glm.formula, na.action = na.omit,data=hold_18mth,family = "binomial")
  print(tidy(glm_model))
  Result_table[j,1] <- names(hold_18mth)[i]
  Result_table[j,2] <- round(exp(coef(glm_model)), 2)[2]#exp
  Result_table[j,3] <- round(exp(confint(glm_model)), 2)[2,1]#exp
  Result_table[j,4] <- round(exp(confint(glm_model)), 2)[2,2]#
  Result_table[j,5] <- round(tidy(glm_model)$p.value,4)[2]
  j <- j+1
}

Result_table_name<-left_join(Result_table, pathway
                        %>% dplyr::select(Metabolites,CHEMICAL_NAME,Super_pathway), by ="Metabolites")##


Result_table_fdr_neu_18mth<-Result_table_name%>%
  mutate(FDR= p.adjust(Result_table_name$p.value,method="fdr"))

Result_table_Significant_neu_18mth <- subset(Result_table_fdr_neu_18mth,p.value<= 0.05)
Result_table_Significant_neu_18mth_log <- Result_table_Significant_neu_18mth %>% mutate(across(c("OR":"CIH"), logtransform))

Result_table_Significant_neu_18mth_log<-Result_table_Significant_neu_18mth_log[with(Result_table_Significant_neu_18mth_log,order(FDR)),]
#######################################################################
Result_table_Significant_neu_18mth_log_20 <- Result_table_Significant_neu_18mth_log%>%
 arrange(desc(abs(OR))) %>%
  slice(1:20)
```

```{r}
Super_pathway <- c("Amino Acid", "Carbohydrate", "Cofactors and Vitamins", "Energy",
                   "Lipid", "Nucleotide", "Partially Characterized Molecules", "Peptide", "Xenobiotics")

hex_colors <- c("#A6CEE3", "#1F78B4", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C",
                "#FB9A99", "#E31A1C", "#FDBF6F", "#FF7F00", "#CAB2D6")

color_scale <- scale_color_manual(values = setNames(hex_colors, Super_pathway))
plot_adhd_w24 <- Result_table_Significant_adhd_w24_log_20 %>%
    group_by(Super_pathway) %>%
    mutate(CHEMICAL_NAME = fct_reorder(CHEMICAL_NAME, p.value)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = OR, y = CHEMICAL_NAME, color = Super_pathway)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = CIL, xmax = CIH), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, color = "grey40") +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text_repel(
        aes(label = if_else(FDR < 0.05, "**", if_else(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))),
        box.padding = 0.15,
        point.padding = 0.05,
        size = 4, segment.color = 'grey50',
        nudge_x = 0.15, 
        nudge_y = 0, 
        direction = "y"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "longdash", color = "grey50") +
    color_scale +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right"
    ) +
    labs(
        y = "", x = "log(OR)", title = "Week24-ADHD-adjusted (20/39)",
        color = "Pathway"
    )
plot_adhd_w24
```

```{r}


# Define Super_pathway and hex color codes
Super_pathway <- c("Amino Acid", "Carbohydrate", "Cofactors and Vitamins", "Energy",
                   "Lipid", "Nucleotide", "Partially Characterized Molecules", "Peptide", "Xenobiotics")
hex_colors <- c("#A6CEE3", "#1F78B4", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C",
                "#FB9A99", "#E31A1C", "#FDBF6F", "#FF7F00", "#CAB2D6")
color_scale <- scale_color_manual(values = setNames(hex_colors, Super_pathway))

# Vector of dataframes and titles
dfs <- list(
    Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log_20,
    Result_table_Significant_adhd_w24_log_20,
    Result_table_Significant_asd_w24_log_20,
    Result_table_Significant_neu_18mth_log_20,
    Result_table_Significant_adhd_18mth_log_20,
    Result_table_Significant_asd_18mth_log_20
)

titles <- c(
    "Week24-Any NDD-adjusted (20/54)",
    "Week24-ADHD-adjusted (20/39)",
    "Week24-Autism-adjusted (20/32)",
    "18 months-Any NDDs-adjusted (20/27)",
    "18 months-ADHD-adjusted (20/30)",
    "18 months-Autism-adjusted (20/56)"
)

# Function to generate a plot from each dataframe
make_plot <- function(df, title) {
    df %>%
        group_by(Super_pathway) %>%
        mutate(CHEMICAL_NAME = fct_reorder(CHEMICAL_NAME, p.value)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = OR, y = CHEMICAL_NAME, color = Super_pathway)) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = CIL, xmax = CIH), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, color = "grey40") +
        geom_point(size = 3) +
        geom_text_repel(
            aes(label = if_else(FDR < 0.05, "**", if_else(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))),
            box.padding = 0.15,
            point.padding = 0.05,
            size = 4, segment.color = 'grey50',
            nudge_x = 0.15, 
            nudge_y = 0, 
            direction = "y"
        ) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "longdash", color = "grey50") +
        color_scale +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
        theme(
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
            panel.grid = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "right"
        ) +
        labs(y = "", x = "log(OR)", title = title, color = "Pathway")
}

# Generate all six plots
plots <- mapply(make_plot, dfs, titles, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

# Combine into 3 columns × 2 rows with shared legend
combined_plot <- (plots[[1]] + plots[[2]] + plots[[3]]) /
    (plots[[4]] + plots[[5]] + plots[[6]]) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "right")

# Print
combined_plot

# Define labels
labels <- c("neu_dev_w24", "adhd_w24", "asd_w24", "neu_dev_18m", "adhd_18m", "asd_18m")

# Define standard column names (after renaming 'name' to 'Metabolites')
standard_names <- c("Metabolites", "OR", "CIL", "CIH", "p.value", "CHEMICAL_NAME", "Super_pathway", "FDR")

# Harmonize and combine
combined_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(dfs), function(i) {
  df <- dfs[[i]]
  
  # Rename 'name' to 'Metabolites' if needed
  if ("name" %in% names(df)) {
    names(df)[names(df) == "name"] <- "Metabolites"
  }
  
  # Ensure correct column order
  df <- df[, standard_names]
  
  # Add group label
  df$group <- labels[i]
  
  return(df)
}))

# Save to CSV
write.csv(combined_df, "combined_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

# Define Super_pathway and hex color codes
Super_pathway <- c("Amino Acid", "Carbohydrate", "Cofactors and Vitamins", "Energy",
                   "Lipid", "Nucleotide", "Partially Characterized Molecules", "Peptide", "Xenobiotics")
hex_colors <- c("#A6CEE3", "#1F78B4", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C",
                "#FB9A99", "#E31A1C", "#FDBF6F", "#FF7F00", "#CAB2D6")
color_scale <- scale_color_manual(values = setNames(hex_colors, Super_pathway))

dfs <- list(
Result_table_Significant_neu_w1_log_20,
Result_table_Significant_adhd_w1_log_20,
Result_table_Significant_asd_w1_log_20,
Result_table_Significant_neu_6mth_log_20,
Result_table_Significant_adhd_6mth_log_20,
Result_table_Significant_asd_6mth_log_20,
Result_table_Significant_neu_6yr_log_20,
Result_table_Significant_adhd_6yr_log_20,
Result_table_Significant_neu_10yr_log_20,
Result_table_Significant_adhd_10yr_log_20,
Result_table_Significant_asd_10yr_log_20
)

titles <- c(
    "Week1-Any NDD-adjusted (20/33)",
    "Week1-ADHD-adjusted (20/39)",
    "Week1-Autism-adjusted (20/93)",
    "6 months-Any NDDs-adjusted (20/46)",
    "6 months-ADHD-adjusted (20/47)",
    "6 months-Autism-adjusted (18/18)",
     "6 years-Any NDDs-adjusted (20/27)",
    "6 years-ADHD-adjusted (20/36)",
    "6 years-Autism-adjusted (20/55)",
     "10 years-Any NDDs-adjusted (20/47)",
    "10 years-ADHD-adjusted (20/44)",
    "10 years-Autism-adjusted (20/21)"
)

# Function to generate a plot from each dataframe
make_plot <- function(df, title) {
    df %>%
        group_by(Super_pathway) %>%
        mutate(CHEMICAL_NAME = fct_reorder(CHEMICAL_NAME, p.value)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = OR, y = CHEMICAL_NAME, color = Super_pathway)) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = CIL, xmax = CIH), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, color = "grey40") +
        geom_point(size = 3) +
        geom_text_repel(
            aes(label = if_else(FDR < 0.05, "**", if_else(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))),
            box.padding = 0.15,
            point.padding = 0.05,
            size = 4, segment.color = 'grey50',
            nudge_x = 0.15, 
            nudge_y = 0, 
            direction = "y"
        ) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "longdash", color = "grey50") +
        color_scale +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
        theme(
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
            panel.grid = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "none"
        ) +
        labs(y = "", x = "log(OR)", title = title, color = "Pathway")
}

# Generate all six plots
plots <- mapply(make_plot, dfs, titles, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

# Combine into 3 columns × 4 rows with shared legend
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3, nrow = 4, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Print or save
combined_plot
# Display the combined plot output Figure 4
Figure4
```
